facts_observed.clockify_projects_archive_tool_behavior: calls UpdateProject with archived=true flag, which issues PUT to main project path
facts_observed.source_code_evidence: oneuser_native_core.go line 74-78: args[archived]=true then s.UpdateProject(ctx, args); project_admin.go line 779: body={archived:true} also uses main PUT path

notes: The /archive sub-path does NOT exist on Clockify API. Both clockify_projects_archive (single project via UpdateProject) and clockify_archive_projects (batch) use PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId} with archived=true in the body. This is ours-only in the spec inventory because the official spec may list a separate archive endpoint but Clockify returns Spring-MVC 404 for it.
